author: ValWood
body: * **PTHR ID & PTN node:** GO:0006896 | Golgi to vacuole transport | IBA with O43747 , PTN000512793 , S000006233 * **Sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):** * **Type of Issue: Erroneous source or erroneous propagation, or other issue** Although not strictly incorrect, AP-1 is TGN ↔ endosomes, not the direct route There is a direct route Golgi to vacuole , which this term probably represents and is AP-3 adaptor TGN → vacuole (yeast) / lysosomes (which is AP-3, ALP pathway) So, although it may affect some localisation to the vacuole/lysosome, it might be a bit misleading (other subunits do not have this annotation). * Add the label 'high priority' if needed. Generally high priority issues affect a lot of proteins, and annotations are incorrect (as opposed to just imprecise).
title: PAINT issue:  Golgi to vacuole
